title: About Quiet Pigment Charged Edges
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 546 recent saved-signal files and 81 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @s3ththompson: My favorite works will always be Hockney's colored pencil drawings. How anyone... and @_unsealed: iwil never stop believing in art. and crypto, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Quiet Pigment Charged Edges: Source-led colored-pencil world as poster crop and overhead scan: a vast warm cream paper field above one dense right-of-center teal-black drawn event, pale tubular rails cutting through it, a chalky turquoise slab across the middle, and a cool gray-blue lower panel with scalloped teeth. Keep hand pressure, rubbed p... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against dark chair interior and cushion seam, chalky turquoise mid-band slab, and left pale tubular rail cut.
